competitors.description:
Given that noone is speaking about @flipcash even after the launch of their tg bot, let me do a quick post: 
> highly speculative, but I like going where there is some friction. 
> new payment app by the Kik founder, token launchpad integrated. 
> Has it’s own stablecoin USDF, for which an Coinbase onramp is coming, as well as USDF listings on Coinbase.
> Broader availability of USDF in the Solana ecosystem planned too. Right now switching back to classic stables comes with a shave off. 
> App is super clunky still, but how you can play it:
> If you check their app, basically I see two plays right now. 
> $moony, first utility play there. Team is linked to Flipcash team itself. 
> $jeffy, first meme there. mooned to 4M on first day, dumped to 0.2m, back to 1.1M today. 
> Very speculative, but you want to make money frontrunning attention. I barely see anything on X, so I allocated earlier this week to have some exposure. Could be nothing of course 🤷‍♂️

competitors.title: 前两天刷推，看到 Quip Network @quipnetwork 那条High roller @rcarback will see you in Vegas next week 时，我愣了一下，不
competitors.description:
前两天刷推，看到 Quip Network @quipnetwork 那条High roller @rcarback will see you in Vegas next week 时，我愣了一下，不是因为他们高调，而是因为太少有人敢这样直面量子这个话题。

4月28日下午3:30，拉斯维加斯，BitGo High Roller Summit。他们的 CTO 坐到 Blockstream 创始人 Adam Back、Project Eleven 的 Alex Pruden 对面，辩题就一个：Quantum Computing: Threat or FUD？

过去两年我参加过不少讨论，量子要么被当成科幻噱头，要么被一句还早带过。但 Quip 不是来吵架的，他们是带着解决方案进会场的。

我忽然想起 2017 年比特币扩容那场争论，也是 Vegas，也是这种把分歧摆上桌的架势。不同的是，这次不再争区块大小，而是争加密世界还能不能安全地活到下一个十年。不管辩论谁赢，这张议程本身，就已经赢了。

@quipnetwork  #quipnetwork #Quip
